title: Agency AI Agent ROI Calculator
subtitle: Model a $50K AI agent build against your billable hour economics in under 90 seconds

inputs.label: AI Agent Build Cost
inputs.hint: Fixed-price quote from your build partner. Domain agents run $40K to $120K, agentic with retrieval runs $60K to $200K.

inputs.label: Annual Maintenance and API Cost
inputs.hint: Hosting, model API spend, monitoring, partner retainer. Default to 15 to 25 percent of build cost.

inputs.label: Hours per Week on This Workflow
inputs.hint: Total team hours, not just one person. Add every account manager, coordinator, and strategist who touches it.

inputs.label: Loaded Hourly Cost of the Team
inputs.hint: Salary plus benefits plus overhead. Account managers $65 to $120, senior strategists $150 to $250.

inputs.label: Billable Rate for the Same Hour
inputs.hint: What you charge clients for that hour. Set to zero if freed hours stay internal with no redeployment.

inputs.label: Realistic Redeployment Rate
inputs.hint: Share of saved hours that actually gets redirected to billable work. Most firms land at 50 to 70 percent.

inputs.label: Expected Error Rate Reduction
inputs.hint: Share of rework and escalation hours the system removes. Onboarding handoffs typically lose 5 to 15 percent.

inputs.label: Build Timeline Until Live
inputs.hint: Window where you pay without saving yet. Most builds in this range ship in 2 to 4 months.

outputs.label: Payback Period
outputs.formula: build_cost / Math.max(1, ((hours_per_week * 52 * loaded_cost) + (hours_per_week * 52 * (redeployment_rate / 100) * billable_rate) + (hours_per_week * 52 * loaded_cost * (error_reduction / 100)) - annual_maintenance) / 12) + build_timeline

outputs.label: 3-Year Net Return
outputs.formula: (((hours_per_week * 52 * loaded_cost) + (hours_per_week * 52 * (redeployment_rate / 100) * billable_rate) + (hours_per_week * 52 * loaded_cost * (error_reduction / 100)) - annual_maintenance) * 3) - build_cost - (((hours_per_week * 52 * loaded_cost) + (hours_per_week * 52 * (redeployment_rate / 100) * billable_rate) + (hours_per_week * 52 * loaded_cost * (error_reduction / 100))) * (build_timeline / 12))

recommendations.text: This clears the 90-Day Payback Rule with room to spare. Sign the SOW and lock the build slot before your team finds a reason to delay another quarter.
Payback lands in the typical mid-market window. Negotiate a milestone-based payment schedule tied to the go-live date to de-risk the build timeline.
Your redeployment assumption is conservative, which is honest. Build a written plan for where the freed hours go before kickoff or this becomes a cost-cut, not a growth lever.
Maintenance is eating more than 30 percent of build cost annually. Push your partner for a fixed retainer cap or move hosting to self-hosted n8n and Supabase to compress this line.
The math does not work at this build price for this workflow. Either find a higher-volume workflow to bundle in, or scope down to a $15K to $25K targeted automation instead of a full agent.
Less than 10 weekly hours rarely justifies a $40K+ agent build. Combine two or three adjacent workflows into one scope, or start with a $10K to $20K point automation.

capture_cta.headline: Get the SOW Negotiation Checklist
capture_cta.description: The 14-point checklist I use with mid-market agencies before signing any AI agent build SOW. Covers payment milestones, IP ownership, maintenance caps, and the three clauses that kill 80 percent of failed builds.
